name: Fog Roll
description: Roll a bank of fog out ahead of the user so that foes in its path lose their footing and their aim.

name: Fog Cover
description: Step behind the rolling bank and let it take the user's shape and soften incoming blows.

name: Rolling Palm
description: Roll out of the bank with a heavy palm that lands before the foe sees it.

name: Edge Alarm
description: Feel the edge of the bank like a skin and know the instant something living crosses it.

name: Thick Fog
description: Thicken the bank until a foe inside it loses every sense of direction.

name: Fog Billow
description: Surge the whole bank forward like a wave of cold wet cloth that shoves back every foe in its path.

name: Outline Smudge
description: Smudge the outline of the body until a foe cannot say where the user's edge begins.

name: Silent Fade
description: Fade an ally's outline and footfall together so that the ally slips past a watching eye.

name: Shape Slip
description: Slip out of the place where the body was and leave only a thin grey shape behind.

name: Grey Parry
description: Turn a blow aside on a sheet of grey mist that gives no firm surface to strike.

name: Fade Jab
description: Jab from a faded outline so that the foe's guard meets only empty grey air.

name: Vanishing Guard
description: Let the outline vanish by half so that every blow lands wide of the true body.

name: Outline Swap
description: Leave a false outline standing in mist and strike from beside it while the foe attacks the false one.

name: Cough Haze
description: Spread a rough haze that sets foes coughing and breaks their rhythm.

name: Sting Mist
description: Fling a puff of stinging mist at the foe's eyes from arm's length.

name: Eye Haze
description: Close a haze across a foe's sight so that the foe swings blind for a breath.

name: Breath Ward
description: Wrap the mouth and nose in clean mist so that no foreign haze can enter the lungs.

name: Lung Fog
description: Thicken the haze round a group until every foe in it gasps and staggers.

name: Chest Ease
description: Draw the lingering haze and poison out of an ally's lungs with a cool pull of mist.

name: Mist Press
description: Press the body into a thin mist and cross a narrow gap in one smooth motion.

name: Slow Seep
description: Seep slowly forward along a floor like a thin tide of vapor.

name: Thin Frame
description: Thin the body to a frame of mist so that a blow slides through the gaps.

name: Seam Fog
description: Send fog into the seams of a barrier and learn where it is thin or open.

name: Cling Mist
description: Let mist cling to a foe's limbs and drag them down as it thickens.

name: Passage Feel
description: Feel across a doorway or screen and learn whether it can be passed as mist.

name: Mist Passage
description: Dissolve into mist to pass a thin barrier of cloth or lattice and reform on the far side.

name: Reform Blow
description: Reform out of mist at the foe's side with a heavy blow already swinging.

name: Brume Gather
description: Gather brume from every damp corner into a grey mantle that fills the user with calm strength.

name: Brume Press
description: Press the gathered brume into a dense fist and strike with it.

name: Brume Screen
description: Draw a screen of brume before the body to take the edge off a strike.

name: Brume Drift
description: Drift forward inside the brume to a spot the foe has not guarded.

name: Brume Hold
description: Let the brume close round a foe's limbs and hold them as damp rope.

name: Brume Mantle
description: Wear the full mantle of brume so that blows lose half their force in the grey.

name: Cooling Brume
description: Lay cool brume over an ally to draw out fever and a light poison.
